messages.content: The client just extended Thursday validation to 6:15 p.m., so I cannot responsibly make the 7:20 flight. Compare the late Thursday nonstop with leaving Friday morning, including the Hyatt extension and every added cost.

I found two workable changes. American has a Thursday nonstop at 9:35 p.m. with limited Main Cabin inventory; the fare difference is $214 and there is no change fee. The Friday nonstop leaves at 8:10 a.m. and has a $96 fare difference. I’m checking whether the Hyatt can extend the same room and whether either exchange changes the ticket-credit terms.
Also account for the airport ride. Which option gives me a reasonable margin from King of Prussia?

For Thursday, leaving the client site around 6:25 p.m. gives an estimated PHL arrival of 7:15-7:35, about two hours before departure at the low end. Traffic could narrow that. The late ride may add $20-$35 above the airport ride already included in the trip estimate. Friday would mean leaving the Hyatt around 5:35 a.m.; no added ground cost beyond the existing estimate.
What did the hotel say about Thursday night?

The Hyatt can keep you in the same room through Friday, July 31. The added night is $219 plus $33.56 tax, or $252.56 total. Because this is a same-day extension, it becomes nonrefundable once confirmed and requires separate approval. The existing July 27-30 reservation remains unchanged until the extension is accepted.
And if we change the flight, do we lose the current ticket value or get another fee?

No change fee applies. American would exchange the current ticket and apply its full value to the replacement; only the quoted fare difference is due. Both replacements remain nonrefundable, with residual value subject to the reissued ticket rules if later canceled. The prices and seats can change until ticketing.
Give me the approval comparison and recommend the arrangement that is actually most feasible. Do not change anything yet.

Approval comparison: Thursday 9:35 p.m. nonstop adds $214 airfare plus an estimated $20-$35 in late-evening rideshare cost, for $234-$249 total. It avoids another hotel night and provides roughly a two-hour airport margin, though heavy traffic is the main risk. Friday 8:10 a.m. nonstop adds $96 airfare and $252.56 lodging, for $348.56 total, with no expected incremental ground cost; the hotel night is nonrefundable once added. Recommendation: approve the late Thursday nonstop because it is $99.56-$114.56 less and avoids lodging approval while retaining a workable margin. Before exchange, verify live seat inventory, the exact $214 difference, and current drive time to PHL. Nothing has been changed or charged.
